key_points: Micron Q4 earnings beat estimates with strong AI-driven demand.
Gross margin reached 86.8% and Q1 guidance was raised.
Stock fell after earnings due to heightened capex forecast and margin guidance concerns.
Analysts remain bullish on long-term AI memory supercycle, though some caution on valuation.
Short-term volatility expected as investors weigh upside vs. near-term execution risks.
